titulo: More of what the teaching team asked for
items: Next to “Mute”, an arrow opens the scene's sound: one click stops it playing in the published tour without losing the files, and it turns back on the same way. “Scene audio” has the same switch and a “Remove” button for ambient sound and for narration.

The “Action (variables)” hotspot is explained with an example, the key and the door, and comes with that change already in place when you add it. Its description makes clear that it is not a treasure or a question.

The viewer's floor plan can be enlarged to almost full screen, its points are easier to hit with a finger and, with “Floor plan open at start” in the tour settings, it shows as a minimap from the beginning.
ZIP export no longer stalls near the end: a download that stops receiving data is cut off and retried, and packages over 4 GB or with more than 65,535 files come out whole.

titulo: What the teaching team asked for
items: ZIP export no longer stops halfway: failed files are retried, and if one still can't be fetched the ZIP is created anyway and lists it in LEEME.md. It is also faster.
Export and Share now explain which option to choose, with a link to the Moodle guide.
"Use current view" really sets the start view: reloading the tour no longer restores the position stored in the browser address.
New links arrive at the destination scene's default view, and the arrivals panel says which view each link uses.
In virtual reality you arrive facing the right way, quiz, form and treasure gates also block the way, and on Android gaze activates hotspots even if the phone moves a little.

One quiz can now hold several questions: they are answered one at a time, with a summary at the end, an optional pass mark and the full score sent through SCORM and LTI. If attempts are limited and run out, the gate opens and the question counts as wrong.
Property sections start collapsed and remember how you left them.
A visible "Mute" button in scenes with sound.
A "Floor plan" button in the scene list, with the steps to build a plan with points that lead to each scene.
Renaming a scene, also from the graph, offers to rename its photo too.
New "Team" section in the sidebar and a "People" button in the editor to share a tour. Teamwork is available on every plan.
In Tour settings: background music for the whole tour (it stops when a scene has its own sound), your own logo, watermark and nadir patch, and badge text.
The "Counter / state" hotspot is now called "Action (variables)", summarises what it does and has a conditions editor without JSON.
"How do I do it?" links to the documentation in quiz, treasure, action, polygon and form.
Long labels can be read in full by tapping them, on phones too.
In a guided visit, when the guide opens a text, an image or a quiz, it also opens for everyone following.
New templates in the Education group: "Graded quiz: trees and seasons" and "Treasure hunt: machines and trades".
An "Unpublished changes" notice next to Publish, and Studio updates itself when a new version is out.
This what's new panel, the "Report a problem" button and the version number in the sidebar.
